Name: ChestEx
Author: berkay2578
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4P4nbwQ/about.png[/img]
ChestEx lets you give names and descriptions to chests, change their capacity and colour in a way never seen before!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Vgy1wLs/how-to-install.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "[i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy the wonders of modern technology!
[*][size=1]Endorse the mod if you liked it. :)[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/g9GG0Xx/technical-stuff.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Works with the latest version of Stardew Valley (v1.5.6).
[*]Works with existing saves.
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer (Everyone can name chests and change their description and colours. Only the host can change row and columns size!).
[*]Recommended to play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8808]Infinite Zoom[/url]﻿ (to unlock UI scale zoom levels!).
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿.
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]ChestsAnywhere[/url]﻿.
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url]﻿.
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1150]UI Info Suite[/url]﻿. ([url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases/latest]Use this unofficial update for SV1.5+[/url]﻿)
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2196]Convenient Chests[/url]﻿. ([url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-44#post-28711]Use this unofficial update for SV1.5+[/url]﻿)
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2545]Remote Fridge Storage[/url]﻿.
[*]Fully compatible with all UI recolour mods!
[*]Should be compatible with (not tested) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿.
[*][b]NOT [/b]compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1623/]Colorful Chests[/url]﻿﻿, as this mod already adds a new color picker.
[*][b]NOT[/b] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1191]Expanded Fridge[/url]﻿, as this mod already modifies fridge size.
[*][b]NOT [/b]compatible with Expanded Storage or Vanilla Expanded Storage﻿, as this mod already modifies storage.
[/list]
